title: P-H3-Image 实测：做俯视图不如 Qwen Image 2.1
titleEn: P-H3-Image — loses to Qwen Image 2.1 on top-down views, and neither can turn to the side
models: P-H3-Image LoRA on MiniMax-H3 FL2VA (pruned int8)
summary: PrunaAI 基于 MiniMax-H3 做的图像生成和编辑模型，8 步出 8 MP。用 4 个自写场景（客厅、小镇广场、后院花园、动画卧室）测“同一个场景换视角”，重点是俯视图，和 Qwen Image 2.1 改图对比，由 Qwen3.8 看图评判。俯视图 P-H3 24 张里 10 张是正上方，Qwen Image 24 张全部至少是陡俯视，两两盲测 22:2、21:3 胜出；45° 高角度两者都行，侧面和反打两个模型都转不过去。
summaryEn: PrunaAI's image generation and editing model built on MiniMax-H3, 8 MP in 8 steps. Four original scenes (a living room, a town square, a backyard garden and an anime bedroom) test re-shooting the same scene from new camera angles, with the top-down view as the focus, against Qwen Image 2.1 edits, judged by Qwen3.8 looking at the images. For top-down views, 10 of 24 P-H3 images were straight overhead, while all 24 Qwen Image results were at least steeply overhead and won the blind pairwise tests 22:2 and 21:3. Both handle a 45° high angle; neither can turn the camera to the side or reverse it. The page is in Chinese.
notes: P-H3 能不能拍到正上方要看场景：客厅和广场 6 次里各有 5 次，后院花园和动画卧室都是 0/6，只抬到高角度或陡俯视。
Whether P-H3 reaches a straight-overhead view depends on the scene: 5 of 6 for the living room and the square, 0 of 6 for the garden and the anime bedroom, which only rise to a high or steep angle.
P-H3 必须走自带的提示词扩写。按模型卡格式手写的编辑提示词（带“其余保持不变”）大多原样照抄输入图，12 张只有 1 张变成正上方。写得更明确（垂直向下、看不到墙和地平线）能把 P-H3 从 4/12 提到 6/12。

P-H3 needs its built-in prompt upsampler. Hand-written edit prompts in the model card's format (with "keep everything else") mostly copied the input; only 1 of 12 turned overhead. A more explicit request (straight down, no walls or horizon) lifted P-H3 from 4/12 to 6/12.
一旦拍成俯视，两者布局都对：原机位一侧在画面下方，物件前后左右关系 92%～97% 对得上。Qwen Image 更爱改家具样子（物件变样 13%～15%）。
Once overhead, both keep the layout: the original camera side ends up at the bottom and 92–97% of pairwise object relations match. Qwen Image changes furniture more often (13–15% of objects altered).
侧面（转 90°）和反打（转 180°）都做不到：P-H3 基本保持原构图，Qwen Image 的反打其实只是左右镜像，连评判模型都被骗过去。
Neither can turn 90° to the side or 180° for a reverse shot: P-H3 keeps the original composition, and Qwen Image's reverse is just a left-right mirror, which fooled the judge model too.
H100 上同卡还常驻别的模型、只剩约 30 GB 显存时，P-H3 int8 改图每张约 12 秒，和 Qwen Image 差不多。要 ComfyUI 主线（0.44）才有它的节点。
On an H100 shared with other resident models, with only about 30 GB of VRAM free, a P-H3 int8 edit took about 12 s, on par with Qwen Image. Its node needs ComfyUI master (0.44).
